notes.title: 🎥 Blue Shutter Is Coming to Kickstarter! | Follow Now to Grab Early Bird Reward
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Blue Shutter[/i] is heading to [b]Kickstarter soon[/b] — and our [b]pre-launch page is live now![/b] 🎯[/p][p]By following the campaign now, you'll get notified [b]the moment we launch[/b], giving you the chance to:[/p][list][*][p]🕰️ Grab [b]limited early bird rewards[/b] before they’re gone[/p][/*][*][p]📸 Be among the very first to back the game[/p][/*][*][p]💬 Help us build early momentum and reach more players[/p][/*][/list][p][b]PRE-KICKSTARTER LINK[/b]: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blueshutter/blue-shutter-a-25d-pixel-art-rpg-adventure?ref=discovery&total_hits=30&category_id=35"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blueshutter/blue-shutter-a-25d-pixel-art-rpg-adventure?ref=discovery&total_hits=30&category_id=35[/url][/p][p][/p][quote][p]Thanks for supporting indie games and strange stories.
Together, we can bring the mystery of [i]Blue Shutter[/i] to life — one flash at a time.[/p][/quote][p]🖤
— The Blue Shutter Dev Team[/p]
